Method of Attack: Stealing browser cookies from cookie storage databases of major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Internet Explorer, Microsoft Edge)
Multi-purpose malware capable of stealing sensitive information, sending spam, and delivering other malware
Impacted Systems: Windows hosts with major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Internet Explorer, Microsoft Edge)
Attack Vector: Delivered as a separate module within Trickbot malware infection
Indicators of Compromise: File named 'cookiesDLL64' found on infected Windows host
Network traffic associated with Trickbot's Cookie Grabber module
